text:
Alex: hey team, first day here — trying to open our Grafana infra dashboards but I get a 403. anyone know who grants access?
Mira: welcome!! :tada: from devex — quick Q: what's the grafana URL and are you signing in via Okta?
Alex: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/infra-latency — signing in with alex@redwood.com via Okta.
onboard-bot: Welcome Alex! Please complete the 'Observability access' step in the onboarding checklist: https://go/redwood/onboard-checklist
Mira: ok cool. two things usually cause this: SSO not fully provisioned or missing dashboard role. steps: 1) confirm Okta added the app, 2) file the Obs Access form and include the exact dashboards/projects. I'll paste links.
Mira: Obs access form: https://go/redwood/obs-access — pick Grafana / Datadog / Sentry and list "infra-latency, model-serving-rt" or whatever you need.
Alex: thanks — filed the form (request #4567). also Datadog shows "access denied" and Sentry doesn't list the project. same request ok?
Mira: yes same request covers all three. include the exact service names in the description. I can triage if the ticket stalls.
Mira: tagging eng-observability: @Jordan to grant read+annotate to infra dashboards; edit perms need dashboard owner approval.
Jordan: hey Alex — I can give Viewer + Comment on the infra and model-serving dashboards. edit requires owner sign-off (we try to avoid wide edit perms). give me 10m and I'll add you to the Grafana team that has access.
Alex: appreciate it. one more: are there curated dashboards or a canonical set for model infra I should be aware of?
Jordan: yes — use the "model-serving-rt" dashboard (uid: abcdef). We also keep a "deploy-impact" panel in that board. If you want to make visual edits, make a fork and propose changes; owners can merge.
Mira: FYI if you need to test alerts, use the staging Datadog workspace — we won't fire production alerts. I can add you to the staging alert channel.
Alex: got grafana read access now, can see panels. datadog still pending but will wait for the ticket. thanks everyone!
Mira: awesome, welcome aboard again :wave: ping here if the access ticket doesn't move in 24h and I'll escalate.
thread_text_short: New hire Alex asking for Grafana/Datadog/Sentry access; Mira and Jordan provide steps and grant read+comment permissions.
